en.title: Welcome to the Porcelain Insulator Collector's World of Mud
en.hook: A quirky hobby where engineers might find unexpected inspiration in collecting porcelain insulators.
key_takeaways: Porcelain insulators have become a niche collector's item.
The post explores the creative use of mud in this hobby.
Despite low HN score, it offers a glimpse into this unique community.
